## Subjective

34yo F, no significant PMH, presents with severe headache (location: left temple, retro-orbital; quality: throbbing, pulsating; severity: 8/10; duration: 6 hours h/o today; timing: with photophobia + nausea; context: started after waking; modifying factors: worse with movement, light). 2nd similar episode in past month, never seen for these. Denies fever, neck stiffness, vision loss, focal weakness. PMH: nil. FHx: mother with migraines. SHx: never smoker, occasional EtOH.

## Objective

VS: BP 128/82, HR 84. Gen: in mild distress, in dim room. HEENT: photophobia, no neck stiffness, fundi normal, no scalp tenderness. Neuro: CN II-XII intact, motor 5/5 throughout, sensation intact, no focal deficits, no dysmetria, gait steady.

## Assessment

1. Migraine without aura, episodic (G43.009) — first formal diagnosis

## Plan

Reviewed migraine history — pattern fits ICHD-3 criteria for migraine without aura. Started sumatriptan 50mg PO PRN headache. Discussed migraine triggers, headache diary recommended. Reviewed red flags requiring urgent re-evaluation. Discussed prophylactic options if frequency > 2/month — will reassess at f/u. F/u 1 month with diary.
